summary: First full test pass of the Atelier virtual jewelry builder (Expo/React Native web + FastAPI). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass covering /api/catalog (4 types, 4 metals, addons), /api/price (base, addons+engraving, invalid type/style, too-many-addons, ring stone), /api/quotes (create returns id not _id, server-side recomputed price, EmailStr 422, empty name 422, invalid style 400, too-many-addons 400, list contains created quote). Frontend: all primary flows verified on mobile viewport 390x844 — home hero + 4 category cards (navigate to Build with type), builder (type-chip-*, style-option-*, metal-option-*, size-option-*, addon-option-*, engraving-input, design-name-input, live preview + caption, builder-total-price updates, charm cap toast 'Up to 5 charms', earrings hides engraving-input, ring stone is single-select with price change), save-design-button shows builder-toast with View button navigating to Saved, saved card tap opens /design/[id], detail shows design-detail-name/price/detail-try-on-teaser, request-quote-button → quote-form validates and submits (quote-success-message), edit-design-button loads design into builder with button label 'Update design' and name field prefilled, delete button requires two taps (confirm state), and saved-empty-state + saved-start-designing-button shown when empty.

react_native_issues.issue: Tapping 'Edit design' from /design/[id] uses router.navigate({pathname: '/build', ...}), causing two instances of testID='builder-screen' to be mounted simultaneously (tab builder + pushed builder). Flow works, but duplicate testID breaks strict selectors. Reference: /app/frontend/app/design/[id].tsx:146

action_items: Optional: use router.push with a dismissible modal or router.replace to avoid mounting two '/build' instances when entering edit mode from the design detail; or scope the duplicate testID. Current UX works end-to-end, but duplicate testIDs may cause strict-selector flakiness in future tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly excludes _id via response_model_by_alias=False and PyObjectId alias; good.
compute_price validation of style/size/metal and max_addons returns clean 400s; good.
Pydantic EmailStr + min_length=1 on name produce 422 for invalid payloads which the frontend handles with a user-friendly message (quote-error-message).
Catalog seeding on startup is idempotent via upsert — safe for repeated restarts.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via src/api.ts (useCatalog/computePrice/createQuote) — no hardcoded URLs.
seed_data_creation: A TEST_User quote was created via POST /api/quotes for list-quotes assertion. One SavedDesign 'TEST_Necklace' was created via the UI in localStorage and subsequently deleted during the delete flow test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_jewelry_api.py is parallel-safe. Pricing formula: (type.base_price + style.price + size.price) * metal.multiplier + sum(addon.price) + (engraving_price if engraving.strip() and engraving_max>0). All testIDs match the review-request list exactly. Saved designs persist in web localStorage.
